text:
Noah: Quick sync — putting up the latest screens for the roles panel. Main asks: can we make the legend easier to scan for admins and reduce cognitive load when someone lands on org settings?

Oliver: Saw the mocks. Two things stood out: 1) legend rows feel dense when there are >8 roles, 2) the SSO toggle helptext is long and pushes other elements down.

Maya: Agreed. Current priority is clarity for first-time admins. We don't need every micro detail visible by default. Thinking: collapse long legend entries into pills with a hover/expand affordance.

Hana: Accessibility check: hover-only reveals are bad for keyboard/screenreader users. If we do collapsible pills, they must be keyboard-expandable and have aria-expanded + visible focus ring. Also ensure contrast for pill text >= 4.5.

Oliver: Good call. Proposal: show compact pill (role name + brief badge), with a small chevron button that expands an inline panel. The chevron should be a proper button (<button aria-controls=\"role-123-details\" aria-expanded=\"false\">).

Sam: Implementation note: expanding inline panels will change DOM height. We should animate height to reduce layout shift. Also prefer lazy-rendering details to avoid extra DOM for 200+ roles.

Maya: UX copy tweak for the SSO toggle: current copy is ~2 lines and uses jargon. Draft: `Require single sign-on for this org (recommended for security-conscious teams)`. Thoughts?

Noah: Shorter might be better. How about: `Enforce SSO for everyone — recommended.` Then small secondary help link: `Why this matters` opens a modal with details.

Hana: Secondary link must be focusable and announced. Modal needs descriptive title and focus trap. Also include a link to audit log implications (where we show enforcement events).

Oliver: Where should the audit log link live? Current mock shows it in the top-right toolbar. Users said they can't find recent enforcement events. Maybe add a prominent quick-filter in the audit view: `SSO enforcement` pre-filter.

Maya: Yes — add a quick-filter CTA: `View SSO events` next to the toggle. Small button, tertiary style. Keyboard accessible.

Sam: Back-end: we already tag events with event_type: `sso.enforce`. Frontend just needs a deep-link: `/orgs/:id/audit?filter=event_type:sso.enforce`. We'll wire that up.

Noah: Nice. Also notes on focus order: when you toggle SSO on, we show an inline confirmation panel with rollout checklist. The panel currently appears below the toggle and receives focus automatically — good for keyboard users. But some users said tab order then lands in the middle of the legend. We should ensure focus goes to the confirmation panel title, and tabbing proceeds logically.

Hana: Confirm: confirmation panel title should be an h2 with tabindex=-1 and focus programmatically on expand. Tabbing should go to primary CTA (`Start rollout`) then secondary (`Cancel`). Add skip-links? Maybe overkill.

Oliver: Layout question: do we keep the audit link inside the confirmation panel only, or show both places (toolbar + panel)? Redundancy might help discoverability.

Maya: Let's do both. Toolbar link for general access, inline link in the confirmation panel for context. Make sure both land on the same filtered audit view.

Noah: Small microcopy asks: change `Start rollout` to `Start SSO rollout` to make the action explicit in the audit logs and user flows.

Hana: Microcopy accessibility: button labels must be explicit when read by screenreaders. Good. Also ensure tooltips have accessible names and not only visual hints.

Sam: One more engineering feasibility note: animated height + lazy render + focus management is doable but needs careful timing so the focus isn't lost during animation. We'll set animation-duration to 160ms and call focus after animationend.

Oliver: I'll update the mock and include keyboard interaction states and motion spec. I'll also produce an alternative that uses a persistent side-panel instead of inline expansion — lower layout shift but more visual distance from the toggle.

Maya: Can you mock both? I'll run a quick user test with 5 admins next week. Objective: measure time-to-find SSO events and success reading the legend.

Noah: Awesome. Action items: Oliver — update mocks (compact pills + chevron button + alt side-panel). Hana — write accessibility checklist for expanders, tooltips, and modal. Sam — wire the deep-link and ensure focus timing works. Maya — schedule 5 participant moderated test. I'll follow up after tests.

design-bot: New mock uploaded: https://figma.redwood.com/file/abc123/roles-legend-compact — comments enabled.

Maya: Thanks all. If anyone has quick copy suggestions for the modal content, drop them here. Prefer short sentences and a 1-liner summary at top.

Oliver: Draft line for modal header: `Why enforcing SSO matters` and first sentence: `Enforcing SSO helps prevent credential-based account takeover and centralizes access control.`

Hana: Add: `When enforced, audit logs will record enforcement events under \"sso.enforce\".`

Noah: Great. Closing notes: make sure the audit deep-link includes a URL-encoded filter and that the confirmation panel has a dismiss keyboard shortcut (Esc).

Maya: I'll collect mock updates and call for a design review on Thursday. :thumbsup:

Sam: 👍 will prototype focus behavior today.
